blogs.t: Buying an NA Plot in Igatpuri: A Practical Checklist
blogs.d: Planning to buy an NA plot in Igatpuri or near Nashik? Check the title, price range, paperwork, location and developer before you sign.
b: Igatpuri has become one of the most searched places for a second home near Mumbai. It sits in the Sahyadri hills, it is well connected by road and rail to Mumbai, Nashik and Shirdi, and land costs far less than in the city. That popularity is also why buyers need to be careful. Here is the checklist the Touchwood Lifespaces team walks every buyer through.
## 1. Start with a clear title

Before you fall in love with a view, check the paperwork. A clean, clear title is the single most important thing in any land deal. Ask for the full ownership history and have it checked independently.

For agricultural land in Nashik district, you will need the 7/12 extract and a valid Farmer Certificate to prove eligibility and ownership. NA (non-agricultural) plots avoid the farmer requirement, which is why most weekend-home buyers choose them.
## 2. Know the going rate

Plot prices in Igatpuri usually fall between ₹1,500 and ₹3,000 per sq. ft, depending on location, view and how developed the project is. Be wary of offers far below this range, and compare what is included: internal roads, water and boundary work all add real value.
## 3. Choose location over size

The best plots are close to both hills and highways: good weather and views on one side, easy access on the other. Land near water bodies is usually more fertile, which matters if you plan a farm or garden. Areas where development is just beginning are often the best value, because prices rise as roads and amenities arrive.
## 4. Look at what the project gives you
- Internal roads and water supply to the plot
- A planned layout, so neighbouring plots are built thoughtfully
- Access to the Mumbai-Nashik highway and Igatpuri station
- Natural surroundings protected by the project plan, not just today's view
## 5. Pick a developer people trust

Trust matters a lot in land deals. Ask for completed projects you can visit and speak to people who have already bought. Touchwood Lifespaces has planned projects such as Hillsyde, Countrysyde, Riversyde and Naturesyde around hills, river and meadow, with clients from India and more than fifteen other countries.
## Lifestyle and investment, together

An NA plot in Igatpuri can be a weekend home, a rental villa or simply land you hold while the area grows. Whichever you choose, the same rule applies: clear title, fair price, good access and a developer who will still answer your call after the sale.
Want to walk a site? [Send an enquiry](/contact/?i=plot#enquire) or [see Touchwood Lifespaces](/ventures/touchwood-lifespaces/).

blogs.t: Planning a Destination Wedding in Igatpuri: Venues, Seasons and a Two-Day Plan
blogs.d: How to plan a destination wedding in Igatpuri near Mumbai: seven venues for every function, the best season, guest stays and pure veg catering.
b: A destination wedding works best when everything is in one place. At Touchwood Bliss in Igatpuri, the lawns, the banquet hall, the villas for your families and the kitchen are all on one property in the Sahyadri hills, so nobody spends the wedding shuttling between hotels and venues.
## Seven venues, one property
Fairytale Weddings at Touchwood Bliss has seven spaces, each suited to a different ritual:
- Machan Lawn and Roots Cafe for Mehendi in the afternoon light
- Poolside Lawn for a bright, colourful Haldi
- Tent Lawn or the Banquet Hall for the Sangeet, with room for a stage and DJ
- Sundowner or Farmside Lawn for pheras with the hills behind you
- The largest lawn, holding up to 800 guests, for the reception
## A simple two-day plan

Most families celebrate over two or three days. On day one, guests arrive to a welcome drink, check in to villas around the property and move to Mehendi in the afternoon, followed by the Sangeet in the evening. On day two, Haldi happens in the cool morning, pheras at sunset as the sky turns gold, and the reception after dark.
## Choosing your season

October to February brings cool, dry days and clear evenings: the safest window for open-air pheras, and the dates that book out first. In the warmer months, plan Haldi in the morning and move the main functions to sunset and later. In the monsoon, Igatpuri turns completely green with mist on the hills, but it also rains heavily, so plan the key functions in the Banquet Hall or covered spaces.
## Food your whole family can share
Touchwood Bliss is a pure veg resort, with Jain menus available, so catering suits every family on both sides. Each function gets its own menu, from a light Haldi brunch to the full reception spread.
## Getting there

Igatpuri is about 120 km from Mumbai, roughly three hours on the Mumbai-Nashik highway, and a short drive from Nashik. Igatpuri station is well connected by train, which makes it easy for guests from Mumbai, Thane, Pune and Nashik.
Thinking about dates? [Plan your wedding with us](/contact/?i=wedding#enquire) or [explore Fairytale Weddings](/ventures/fairytale-weddings/).

blogs.t: Best Time to Visit Igatpuri: A Season-by-Season Guide
blogs.d: When to visit Igatpuri: monsoon waterfalls, cool winter weekends and summer mornings, plus places to see near Bhavali Dam.
b: Igatpuri sits at around 2,100 ft in the Western Ghats, about 120 km from Mumbai. That height gives it cooler weather than the city for most of the year, and every season has its own reason to go.
## Monsoon: June to September

This is Igatpuri's most famous season. The hills turn green, waterfalls come alive and mist rolls across the valleys. Roads can be slow in heavy rain, so leave early and plan indoor time. It is the season for photographers, long walks and hot food by the window.
## Winter: October to February

Cool, clear days and crisp evenings make this the best time for weekends, family trips and celebrations. It is also wedding season, so popular dates book out early. Evenings are made for bonfires and open lawns.
## Summer: March to May
Afternoons get warm, but mornings and evenings stay pleasant in the hills. Plan outdoor activities early, spend the afternoon by the pool, and head out again at sunset.
## Places to visit near Bhavali Dam
- Bhavali Dam, a quiet reservoir surrounded by hills
- Camel Valley, known for its monsoon waterfalls
- Vihigaon Waterfall
- The trek to Kalsubai, the highest peak in Maharashtra
## Where to stay

Touchwood Bliss on Bhavali Dam Road is a pure veg family resort with private pool villas, mountain views and space for children and pets, rated 4.8 by over 12,000 guests. It is within an easy drive of all the places above.
Planning a trip? [Send a stay enquiry](/contact/?i=stay#enquire) or [see Touchwood Bliss](/ventures/touchwood-bliss/).

blogs.t: A Family Getaway Near Mumbai: What to Look For in an Igatpuri Resort
blogs.d: Planning a family weekend near Mumbai? What to compare in an Igatpuri resort: space, food everyone can share, things for kids and an easy drive.
b: Igatpuri has no shortage of resorts, so it helps to know what to compare. For a family trip, the best resorts give you space instead of crowded corridors, food your whole group can share, things for every age to do and an easy drive from the city.

With grandparents, children and sometimes a pet, rooms in a corridor rarely work. Look for villas. At Touchwood Bliss, you can choose the biophilic Amora Villa, the spacious Farmsyde Villa with its own pool, or the Kerala-inspired Courtyard Villa with an infinity pool facing the mountains.
## Food everyone can eat
Mixed groups often have vegetarian and Jain members. A fully pure veg kitchen, with Jain meals on request, means nobody has to compromise, and the whole family eats together.
## Something for every age
- A kids play area and indoor and outdoor games
- A swimming pool with nature views
- Bonfire evenings and open lawns
- Pet-friendly villas, so nobody stays home
## An easy drive
Igatpuri is about 120 km from Mumbai, around three hours on the Mumbai-Nashik highway, and a short drive from Nashik. You can also take the train to Igatpuri station.
## Check the reviews
Ratings from thousands of guests tell you more than any brochure. Touchwood Bliss is rated 4.8 from over 12,000 guest reviews, with families often mentioning the space, the food and the calm.

blogs.t: Harmony, Not Balance: How Working Women Can Bring Career, Family and Self Together
blogs.d: Why so many successful women feel unfulfilled, and how harmony coaching helps across professional, personal and family life.
b: She is managing her career, nurturing relationships, meeting expectations and taking care of everyone. From the outside she is doing it all. But is she feeling fulfilled?
That question sits at the heart of The Harmony Movement and Harmony & Her, led by Rupali Surana, a Women Harmony Coach and Chief Happiness Officer at Touchwood.
## Why harmony, not balance

Balance suggests a scale, where giving more to one side means taking from the other. Harmony is different. Rupali believes women do not need to choose between success and happiness, ambition and well-being, or relationships and individuality. They can create harmony between them.
## Three dimensions of harmony
- Professional harmony: build career clarity, confidence and leadership while managing pressure, ambition and growth, and grow without losing yourself.
- Personal harmony: reconnect with your emotions, identity, confidence, well-being and inner peace.
- Family harmony: create stronger relationships through communication, compassion, bonding and healthy boundaries, and love deeply without losing yourself.
## How the work happens

Through one-to-one coaching, group programmes, Harmony Circles, workshops and retreats, women are given space to pause, reflect, reconnect and consciously create the life they want. Retreats at Touchwood Bliss add breathwork and time in nature.
## You do not have to wait for burnout
You do not have to wait for a crisis, or have all the answers. You simply need to take the first step.
Want to know more? [Send an enquiry](/contact/?i=retreat#enquire) or [see The Harmony Movement](/ventures/harmony-movement/).

blogs.t: Inside the Touchwood Hive: An Office Built Like a Honeycomb
blogs.d: A look inside the Touchwood Hive, our Nashik office designed around honeycombs, plants and people, and the culture it supports.
b: Every part of the Touchwood group, from real estate to resorts, retreats and branding, is run from one place: the Touchwood Hive, our corporate office at JITO Business Bay, Mumbai Naka, Nashik.
## Why a hive

Bees build together, each doing its part for the colony. That idea runs through how we work, and it shaped the office itself. Hexagons appear everywhere: in the railing around the central stair, on the walls and in the frames that hold our team's photos.
## Green, open and full of light

The Hive is designed to feel more like a garden than a corporate floor. Shelves of plants rise from floor to mezzanine, natural light comes in through tall windows, and open seating replaces closed cabins wherever possible. It is the same nature-first thinking that shapes our projects in Igatpuri.
## People are our brand

One wall says it plainly: our people are our brand. Team portraits hang in honeycomb frames, and a Happiness Corner keeps notes, ideas and celebrations visible to everyone. The group has a Chief Happiness Officer, Rupali Surana, whose role is to keep people, culture and positivity at the centre.
## A place to learn
The Hive hosts regular training sessions, team meetings and celebrations, so learning happens where the work happens.
See it for yourself in the [Touchwood Hive gallery](/hive/), or [explore careers](/careers/) if you would like to work here.

blogs.t: Why Igatpuri Is Becoming Maharashtra's Wellness Destination
b: Igatpuri sits in the Sahyadri hills, about 120 km from Mumbai and a short drive from Nashik. Misty monsoons, waterfalls and quiet valleys make it a natural escape from city life.

The best time to visit is the monsoon, June to September, when the hills turn green and waterfalls come alive. October to February brings cool, clear weather for weekends and celebrations. Bhavali Dam, Camel Valley, Vihigaon Waterfall and the Kalsubai trek are all close by.
That calm is why more travellers now come for retreats and slow weekends. Touchwood Bliss and Harmony Retreat were built around exactly that idea: nature first, rest first.
For land buyers, the same qualities, clean air, open views and the Samruddhi Highway nearby, make Igatpuri an interesting place to own a plot with Touchwood Lifespaces.
